prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game animation SPRITE ATLAS for ONE protagonist, ONE weapon, ONE viewing direction. A strict 3 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid of exactly equal square cells on a square canvas. Only SEVEN occupied cells: row1 cells1-3, row2 cells4-6, row3 ONLY cell7 at LEFT; bottom-middle and bottom-right cells8-9 completely empty transparent. Read order left-to-right, top-to-bottom. No grid lines, boxes, labels, text, borders, background or shadows. Entire canvas genuinely transparent outside the seven figures. Each occupied cell has exactly ONE full body character and its held weapon, never overlaps another cell. Center each character in its own cell; all seven figures have EXACTLY the same body scale and head size, aligned pelvis and consistent baseline. Generous transparent margin INSIDE each cell, especially for weapon reach. Keep body approximately 58 percent of cell height so spear and swings fit. Minimal basic geometric polygon 2D cutout art, few large flat matte faces; dark charcoal gray and muted dark ochre, no fine texture, no realism, no glow or hazy halos. Fixed elevated 45-degree orthographic game camera. Input image 1 is protagonist identity and camera reference ONLY, ignore its running pose. Input image 2 is the weapon shape ONLY, ignore its large display scale. Character: short angular charcoal black hair, blank beige face without eyes or facial details, muted dark ochre open jacket with simple lapels over charcoal shirt, dark gray cargo trousers with one thigh pocket, block dark boots. Preserve this exact protagonist, same clothes, limb thickness and proportions. Facing EAST: directly screen RIGHT; strict RIGHT side profile, torso and both feet point right, not toward viewer. Head, torso, hips, feet and attack direction must agree. Do not rotate the bitmap or mirror it. Weapon identity: ONE compact handheld crossbow, short ochre wood stock, charcoal transverse bow limbs and ONE string; about forearm length, NOT a huge mounted ballista.. Anatomical handedness stays fixed across all cells, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs per figure. All seven faces/torso/feet and attack actions maintain this SAME viewing direction.
CELL 1 (row 1, column 1): 持械站立.  STANDING STILL: straighten torso, both feet firmly planted shoulder-width apart, relaxed knees, no running stride. Right hand grips trigger stock, left hand supports forward underside; crossbow low across waist, muzzle toward facing direction.
CELL 2 (row 1, column 2): 迈步A.  RUN frame 1, stride A: anatomical LEFT thigh swings forward toward facing direction with bent knee; RIGHT leg extends behind, legs visibly separated. Slight forward body lean. Both hands carry compact crossbow low across waist, elbows bent, stock and horizontal limbs stay intact; legs run, no huge arm swing. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 3 (row 1, column 3): 经过.  RUN frame 2, compact passing: thighs near each other under hips, LEFT foot down beneath pelvis, RIGHT knee bent and foot lifting upward past the planted leg. Body rises only a little; NOT a wide stride. Both hands carry compact crossbow low across waist, elbows bent, stock and horizontal limbs stay intact; legs run, no huge arm swing. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 4 (row 2, column 1): 迈步B.  RUN frame 3, opposite stride B: anatomical RIGHT thigh now swings forward toward facing direction with bent knee; LEFT leg extends behind. This MUST swap the leading leg compared with frame 1, not repeat stride A. Both hands carry compact crossbow low across waist, elbows bent, stock and horizontal limbs stay intact; legs run, no huge arm swing. Keep arms correctly holding the weapon, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. No attack action, no motion blur.
CELL 5 (row 2, column 2): 蓄力/瞄准.  ATTACK frame 1 of 3: Raise compact crossbow to chest aiming along facing direction; right hand at trigger and left supporting front. ONE short bolt seated on rail. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
CELL 6 (row 2, column 3): 出手/释放.  ATTACK frame 2 of 3: Fire: slight upward/backward recoil with elbows flexed, muzzle still toward facing direction. Crossbow rail empty, no detached bolt, no giant flash. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
CELL 7 (row 3, column 1): 收招/复位.  ATTACK frame 3 of 3: Lower compact crossbow toward waist; right hand keeps grip while left hand moves onto top rail to begin resetting, torso relaxes. Torso and feet stay oriented toward facing direction; head remains aligned. Exactly two arms and legs. No target, no gore, no impact scene, no motion trail.
Strict grid coordinates: each column exactly one third of canvas width; each row exactly one third of canvas height. Occupied cells 1-7 only; 8-9 truly empty. No detached projectiles, targets or extra figures. All motion is shown by actual changed limb positions, not ghosting or motion trails.
